subject: Re: GaterNet kickoff — input-conditional compute
body:
Hi Lucia,

Staffing: Rosa 60% (repro and eval), Vera 50% (internal workload port), Rafael 40% (analysis), Umar 20% (advisory).

Compute: the CIFAR-10 work is trivial, titan best-effort covers it. The June scale decision is the real ask — for the ImageNet-scale gating sweep we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-06-01, 256 accelerators from the vision portfolio's quarterly allocation. The sweep covers backbone depths and gate-sparsity targets.

Dependency: the released checkpoints download from external storage; Vera is mirroring ResNet-20-Gated.pth and ResNet-56-Gated.pth internally this week so CI does not depend on an external URL.

Deshawn
